kyoto_arachan_higashiyama.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: okonomiyaki, negiyaki and yakisoba (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_arachan_higashiyama.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork, seafood, A5 beef and egg (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_arachan_higashiyama.hours_raw: Mon and Wed–Sun 11:30–1:00 (last order 0:00); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Lunch set meals (February and October 2025). Tabelog says no cards, but an October 2025 diner paid by card and PayPay. 40 seats incl. a tatami room; whole-shop hire for up to 20 (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Takeaway (Tabelog). On Higashioji by the Chion-in bus stop, near Gion Kagetsu, 6 min from Gion-Shijo (Tabelog; September and December 2025).
kyoto_arachan_higashiyama.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Higashioji, to 1 am] A cheerful okonomiyaki and teppan house by Gion Kagetsu theatre, its walls covered in comedians’ autographs: fluffy okonomiyaki, negiyaki, yakisoba, A5 diced steak and tongue, with good-value lunch sets (buta-tama ¥1,150) and late hours. Smoking allowed; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: an okonomiyaki shop near the Gion Kagetsu theatre, popular with Yoshimoto comedians, now adding creative teppan dishes.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 regular brought a work party of 15 for the banquet course and noted it is a favourite of Yoshimoto comedians.
A December 2025 solo diner nearly skipped it as a regulars-only place, then came back and found it the best option nearby.
A February 2025 lunch guest had food on the table about five minutes after ordering.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: お好み焼き、東山区大和大路新橋東入ル林下町438、阪急河原町駅から徒歩10分、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩6分、月・水〜日・祝日11:30〜翌1:00 (L.O. 0:00)、火曜休み、カード不可 (2025年10月の口コミではカードと PayPay 可)、40席、座敷、喫煙可、テイクアウト、ふわふわのお好み焼き、A5 の角切りステーキ、京都の豆腐と Kujo ねぎの料理、常連に人気の卵焼き。口コミ (2022年10月〜2026年11月、英語): 祇園花月の近く、芸人のサインがいっぱい、昼の定食 (豚玉定食1,150円)、タンとリブロース、15名の宴会コース、ねぎ焼き、焼きそば、海鮮のお好み焼き、目玉焼きのせの豚ねぎ焼き。

cultural_comfort.note: Walk in for the lunch sets; book for groups. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_teppan_sosaku_rian.gf_detail: Ask. Teppan wagyu courses with seasonal vegetables (2025–26 reviews); wagyu fillet katsu sandwiches are also sold (Tabelog); no gluten information.
kyoto_teppan_sosaku_rian.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu teppan restaurant (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_teppan_sosaku_rian.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:30–22:00; closed Sunday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「無し」). Cards and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 16 seats: a 10-seat counter and a private room for 6 (Tabelog). Bukkoji-dori east of Karasuma, 1 min from Shijo or Hankyu Karasuma (Tabelog). Opened 18 January 2019 (Tabelog).
kyoto_teppan_sosaku_rian.notes: [Wagyu teppan · Shijo-Karasuma, since 2019] A ten-seat teppan counter plus a private room just off Shijo-Karasuma, cooking Kuroge wagyu — Matsusaka strip loin, Chateaubriand, prize-winning Ushi no Nakayama fillet — in kaiseki-style courses with Kyoto vegetables and a 50-strong wine and sake list. Polished service; wagyu katsu sandwiches to order. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a teppanyaki restaurant opened in January 2019, serving Kyoto-cuisine-inspired meat dishes of selected Kuroge wagyu and seasonal Kyoto ingredients; a March 2025 diner notes staff from the Imperial Hotel.

anecdotes.text: A March 2025 diner, served by staff from the Imperial Hotel, was left speechless by the Chateaubriand.
A September 2026 diner found the salad of vegetables from across Kyoto and Japan a star in its own right before the fillet.
A July 2025 business guest called the course an ultimate meat kaiseki.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ・公式サイト: 鉄板焼き・日本料理・牛肉料理、下京区仏光寺通烏丸東入ル上柳町328、地下鉄四条駅・阪急烏丸駅から徒歩1分、月〜土17:30〜22:00、日曜休み、サービス料なし、カード・PayPay 可、16席 (カウンター10、個室6)、2019年1月18日オープン、厳選した黒毛和牛と京都の旬の食材の京料理風の肉料理、おまかせコース (松阪牛ストリップロイン100g 28,600円、シャトーブリアン100g)、ワインと日本酒50種以上、黒毛和牛ヒレのカツサンド (予約制)。口コミ (2019年9月〜2026年9月、英語): 帝国ホテル出身のスタッフ、シャトーブリアン、肉の会席、綾部・城陽・大原の野菜と加賀れんこんのサラダ、Ushi no Nakayama の黒毛和牛ヒレ100g。

cultural_comfort.note: Reserve a course; private room for six. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and official site; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_maeda_toyosaburo_shoten.gf_detail: Ask. A wine and sake shop with a tasting counter; drinks only in the sources (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_maeda_toyosaburo_shoten.vegan_detail: Ask. Natural wines, sake and craft beer at the counter (2025–26 reviews); no vegan information.
kyoto_maeda_toyosaburo_shoten.hours_raw: Daily 10:00–21:00; may change (Tabelog). Cards (Tabelog). A 6-seat counter (Tabelog). Bottles of over ¥3,000 from the shelves can be opened at the counter with no corkage (November 2025). Yaoichi Honkan 2F, Higashinotoin south of Sanjo (Tabelog).
kyoto_maeda_toyosaburo_shoten.notes: [Wine and sake counter · Higashinotoin-Sanjo] A liquor shop on the second floor of Yaoichi Honkan with a six-seat counter where you can drink natural wine, local sake or craft beer by the glass from 10:00 to 21:00 — or open a bottle from the shelves (over ¥3,000) with no corkage. A handy stop while shopping.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: a wine and sake shop inside Yaoichi Honkan with a tasting counter.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 regular opened a Champagne bought in the shop at the counter, free of corkage over ¥3,000.
A February 2026 visitor found warmth there on a snowy Kyoto night.
A September 2026 shopper had a glass of orange wine while waiting for the day’s deli dish.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ワインバー、中京区東洞院三条下る三文字町220 八百一本館 2F、毎日10:00〜21:00、カード可、6席。口コミ (2014年11月〜2026年9月、英語): 自然派ワイン、地酒、クラフトビールをカウンターで、3,000円以上のボトルは持ち込み料なし、昼に一杯とワインの購入、百貨店の地下のようなカウンター、オレンジワイン。

cultural_comfort.note: Order a glass at the counter or pick a bottle from the shelves.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_maeda_toyosaburo_shoten.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260202/26024716/ (35.007634, 135.761305); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市中京区三文字町220番地 (lot) 32m; 2026-11-08

kyoto_sushi_ryuka.gf_detail: Ask. Sushi on red-vinegar rice with soy and cooked side dishes; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_ryuka.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi omakase (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_ryuka.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday and Thursday–Sunday 18:00–22:30, two seatings at 18:00 and 20:30; closed Wednesday, though a Wednesday may be arranged in advance (Tabelog). Reservations through TableCheck ("Kyoto Sushi Ryuka - 鮨 流嘉"); seat requests may change (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), e-money and QR (Tabelog). 11 seats: 7 at the counter and a private room with a table for 4 (Tabelog). Gokomachi above Oike, a short walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; September 2025). Opened in summer 2025 (June–August 2025 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_ryuka.notes: [Sushi · Gokomachi-Oike, 11 seats] A new, glossy sushi counter near City Hall serving a ¥20,000 omakase of thick-cut fish on red-vinegar rice, with seasonal rarities and showy pieces topped with caviar and truffle. Two seatings nightly; book on TableCheck. Some 2026 guests found the service and pairings unpolished.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: a sushi counter that opened in summer 2025 near Kyoto City Hall, with a modern, gold-accented interior and an entertaining chef (July 2025–February 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Authentic sushi for everyday Kyoto, easy for first-timers (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 diner discovered unfamiliar seasonal fish such as aburabozu and called the wild tuna the best ever eaten.
A February 2026 guest liked the fish but found the pieces piled with smoked meat, caviar and truffle too much luxury on luxury.
A January 2026 visitor praised the sushi but found the service let down by a new part-time staff member.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 寿司、中京区御幸町通御池上る亀屋町384、市役所前駅のすぐ近く、月・火・木〜日 18:00〜22:30、2部制 (18:00・20:30)、水曜休み (事前相談で可)、予約は TableCheck「Kyoto Sushi Ryuka - 鮨 流嘉」から、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners・銀聯)・電子マネー・QR 可、11席 (カウンター7、4名の個室1)。口コミ (2025年6月〜2026年9月、英語): 2025年夏の開店、赤酢のシャリ、厚く贅沢なネタ、天然のまぐろ、あぶらぼうずなど珍しい季節の魚、おまかせ流嘉コース20,000円 (税込)、燻製の肉・キャビア・トリュフをのせた握り、金を使った内装、楽しい料理人、新しいアルバイトの接客が不慣れだったとの声 (2026年1月)、組み合わせがいまひとつとの声 (2026年3月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Book on TableCheck; two seatings; cards, IC and QR.

kyoto_kaisen_tokidoki_buta.gf_detail: Ask. Raw-fish bowls may suit, but the marinated salmon and tuna sauces, soy and sauce katsu are not wheat-free; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kaisen_tokidoki_buta.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood bowls, sauce katsu and pork miso soup (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_kaisen_tokidoki_buta.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–21:00 (last order 20:30), closing early when sold out (Tabelog). Reservations through Tabelog only, not by phone; a seat-only booking costs ¥200 unless you order a drink (Tabelog original 席だけ予約の場合のみ200円). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 27 seats: 7 at the counter and tables for 2 and 4 (Tabelog). Take-away available (Tabelog). Daihachi Hase building B1F on Karasuma below Bukkoji; a few minutes from Shijo Stn (Tabelog; August 2026).
kyoto_kaisen_tokidoki_buta.notes: [Seafood bowls · Karasuma-Bukkoji, basement, cash only] A casual basement bowl shop near Shijo-Karasuma where you build a kaisen-don from some 28 toppings — tuna, marinated salmon, negitoro, ikura — from ¥900, or try the Fukui sauce katsu; a cheap weekday set until 2 p.m. Solo-friendly. Some found the fish ordinary for the price.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: a seafood-bowl and set-meal shop in a basement near Shijo-Karasuma offering customisable bowls of seasonal fish, bluefin tuna and salmon, and Fukui-style sauce katsu, with friendly staff (2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 salmon lover booked the social-media-only bowl, ¥2,200 and five a day, and piled on marinated salmon until saying stop.
A March 2026 diner arriving just before closing was kindly served a cheap and delicious toro-taku bowl.
An April 2026 visitor found the tuna fishy and the bowl no better than a chain's.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 海鮮丼・食堂・海鮮、下京区烏丸通仏光寺下ル大政所町680-1 第八長谷ビル B1F、毎日 11:00〜21:00 (L.O.20:30)、売り切れ次第終了、予約は食べログのみで電話不可、席だけの予約は200円 (ドリンク注文で不要)、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、27席 (カウンター7、テーブル)、テイクアウト可、約28種から選ぶ海鮮丼900円から、本まぐろ、鮭、福井のソースかつ、鯛のあら汁、豚汁。口コミ (2026年1月〜8月、英語): 平日14時までのサービス丼980円、SNS 限定・予約制で1日5食の漬けサーモンのせ放題2,200円、ねぎとろ・とろたく、鯛、海老、しらす、いくらや卵黄の追加、まぐろ・いか・アボカド・海苔の韓国風の丼、一人でも入りやすい、値段のわりに普通・まぐろが生臭いとの声 (2026年1・4月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; book via Tabelog only; solo-friendly.

kyoto_ryoma_sanjo_karasuma.gf_detail: Not GF: fried dishes and soy-based simmered fish (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_ryoma_sanjo_karasuma.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood and chicken izakaya (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_ryoma_sanjo_karasuma.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 18:00–3:00 (last orders food 2:00, drinks 2:30); closed Sunday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; banquet courses (Tabelog). The appetiser is grilled at the table on a small charcoal grill and was thought pricey (September 2024; August 2026). Cards; no e-money (Tabelog). 70 seats with a counter and a sunken-kotatsu room for 14 (Tabelog). Non-smoking since April 2020 (Tabelog). No phone signal in the basement (November 2024). Sanjo COHJU building B1F, Sanjo east of Karasuma, near the Museum of Kyoto (Tabelog).
kyoto_ryoma_sanjo_karasuma.notes: [Seafood izakaya · Sanjo-Karasuma basement, till 3 a.m.] A big, busy basement izakaya open until 3 a.m., with fish from around Japan, charcoal-grilled chicken and an appetiser you grill yourself on a shichirin. Popular with students and office workers; non-smoking. The appetiser charge is on the high side. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: a 70-seat seafood izakaya near Sanjo-Karasuma open until 3 a.m. with seasonal seafood delivered daily and banquet courses (2024–2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 diner found fish here that are rarely seen in Kyoto, at fair prices.
A November 2025 group, finding the Oike bars closing early, came here for a second round and grilled the appetiser on the shichirin.
An August 2026 regular enjoyed the charcoal-grilled black chicken but felt the once-rare sashimi had become ordinary.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・海鮮・鍋、中京区三条通烏丸東入ル梅忠町24 三条COHJUビル B1F、京都文化博物館の近く、月〜土 18:00〜翌3:00 (L.O.料理2:00、飲み物2:30)、日曜休み、予約可、宴会コース、カード可、電子マネー不可、70席、14名の掘りごたつの個室、2020年4月から店内禁煙。口コミ (2024年6月〜2026年9月、英語): 七輪で焼く先付 (とびうおのひれ、いわし、海老など)、京都では珍しい魚の刺身、あぶらぼうずの煮付け、黒鶏の炭火焼き、焼き物、鍋、メニューが豊富、学生から会社員まで、お通しがやや高いとの声、地下で電波がない (2024年11月)、刺身が普通になったとの声 (2026年8月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Late night; non-smoking; appetiser charged; cards.

kyoto_torikyu_maruyama.gf_detail: Ask. Mizutaki chicken broth may suit, but it is served with ponzu, and kaiseki and sukiyaki use soy; no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_torikyu_maruyama.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken mizutaki, beef and fish (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_torikyu_maruyama.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–22:00 (last orders food 20:30, drinks 21:00); closing days irregular (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). No charge for appetisers (Tabelog original お通し代なし). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR; ask about payment for banquets (Tabelog). 200 tatami seats; private rooms for 2 to over 30 (Tabelog). A designated smoking area (Tabelog). In the north woods of Maruyama Park, next to Yasaka Shrine; about 15 min by car from Kyoto Stn (Tabelog; February 2024).
kyoto_torikyu_maruyama.notes: [Mizutaki and kaiseki · Maruyama Park] A ryokan-like house in Maruyama Park, said to date from 1896, serving Nagoya Cochin chicken mizutaki in private tatami rooms — rich broth, homemade ponzu, porridge to finish — plus yudofu and seasonal Kyoto gozen. Kind, attentive staff. Cash only.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a renowned restaurant of over 100 years in Maruyama Park, serving seasonal Kyoto kaiseki and hot pots such as mizutaki. A November 2024 reviewer gives its founding as 1896.
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal Kyoto kaiseki and traditional hot pots (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A March 2024 former university club member came back for a farewell party, as the club always had, and the staff kept out of the room during speeches.
A May 2024 visitor's mother felt cold and the staff promptly brought a lap blanket.
An October 2026 birthday party had the Wakadori mizutaki at ¥6,600 and a complimentary agedashi tofu.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理・鍋、東山区円山公園北林、毎日 11:00〜22:00 (L.O.料理20:30、飲み物21:00)、不定休、予約可、お通し代なし、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、宴会の支払いは相談、200席 (座敷)、個室 (2名〜30名以上)、分煙、創業100年以上の老舗、円山公園で季節の京懐石と水炊きなどの鍋。口コミ (2024年2月〜2026年10月、英語): 八坂神社の隣、旅館のような雰囲気、名古屋コーチンの水炊きと自家製ポン酢、締めのおかゆ、若鶏の水炊き6,600円 (2026年10月)、1896年創業との声 (2024年11月)、Yasaka 御膳 (おぼろ豆腐、鱧、赤だし)、湯豆腐の会席、和牛ステーキの御膳、夏のすき焼き、ていねいな接客。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; private tatami rooms; book ahead.
